description: Returns ERROR and WARN entries from the project's .log files (logs/, log/ and the project root), with stack traces, timestamps and repeat counts. Secrets are redacted. Use this when the snapshot shows errors and you need more than its 10 most recent, or the full stack traces.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root. Optional: defaults to the client's workspace root, or the server's working directory.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return, newest last. Default 50.

name: get_recent_errors
title: Recent log errors
